title: Discovering Physical Representation Languages
abstract: arXiv:2609.23381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before a machine can discover a physical law, it must discover what its measurements are: which observations live on cells, which are intensive or extensive, which sectors are dual, and which distinctions are merely gauge. We introduce physical representation-language discovery, the problem of recovering this hidden ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We give an identifiability theory and constructive polynomial-time procedure that recovers a carrier and differential sequence, measurement types and orientation twist, noninvertible refinement semantics, primal-dual Maxwell diagrams, and the residual equivalences that no permitted experiment can break. The theory turns material nuisance into a commutant, uses refinement to separate quantities from coordinates, and selects physics only after its representation has been recovered. translated_abstract: 在机器能够发现物理定律之前，它必须先发现它的测量是什么：哪些观测存在于胞腔上，哪些是强度量或广延量，哪些扇区是对偶的，哪些区别仅仅是规范性的。我们引入了物理表示语言发现这一新问题，即直接从匿名受控实验中恢复这一隐藏本体论的问题。我们给出了一个可辨识性理论和构造性的多项式时间程序，该程序能够恢复载体和微分序列、测量类型和定向扭转、不可逆的细化语义、原-对偶麦克斯韦图，以及任何被允许的实验都无法打破的残余等价关系。该理论将材料干扰转化为交换子，利用细化将量与坐标分离，并且只有在其表示被恢复之后才选择物理。对于一个经过认证的有限实验族，我们证明了端到端的两阶段测量界……
tldr: 该论文提出了“物理表示语言发现”这一新问题，并给出可辨识性理论与多项式时间构造算法，能够直接从匿名受控实验中恢复测量的隐藏本体结构（包括载体、微分序列、测量类型、对偶结构及不可打破的残余等价关系等）。
